description: DISP-01 end to end, gate 3: offer and money model both clear (an attraction offer plus continuity, a lifetime figure on file) and NO lead channel is running — the diagnostic routes to lead-engine, the gap is tapped, and the specialist's grounded memo lands at the Approve gate. Completes the three-route dispatch set (29 offer, 30 money model, 31 leads) that one pinned run certifies together. ASYMMETRY THIS CASE MUST CARRY (diagnose.ts:126, and why run c1fe054c landed on money-model-designer instead): gate 3 is reached only by SURVIVING gate 2's `offerTypeCount <= 1`, and `modelCard.offerTypesPresent` defaults to all-false (scorecard.ts: a checklist, not an unknown) with NO vault-grounding path — nothing but an explicit `recordScorecardAnswer` can raise it. So 29/30 pass on defaults while 31 needs TWO offer types affirmatively on the scorecard; turn 1 therefore states them as live in the same breath it closes off upsell and downsell. Strengthening, not relaxing: the expectation block is untouched.
turns: Context to keep on file about my business, the Northwind logistics platform. We sell a done-for-you shipment onboarding package as our attraction offer, and customers then stay on a monthly monitoring plan — that is our continuity offer. Put both on my scorecard as things we sell today: the attraction offer is live and the continuity offer is live, and there is no upsell and no downsell. Lifetime gross profit per customer (LTGP) is about 3200 dollars.
On acquisition, be blunt in the record: we run no outreach at all right now. No warm outreach, no posted content, no cold outreach, no paid ads — not one channel is active.
That's everything. Now evaluate my business using my vault and what I've told you.
